result.brief: 在统一框架下实例化四种 VLA 世界模型范式，系统比较不同世界表征与策略骨干，发现 2D 语义表征跨范式稳健有效，解耦 MoT 未来专家在 OOD 与长时序任务上更优。
result.reason: Systematically ablates world representations and integration paradigms for VLA world models, finding 2D semantic representations give cross-paradigm gains—direct evidence on representation choice.
